/**
   * Deletes the messages with the given IDs from the server.
   *
   * @param listener - Listener to indicate the success or failure of the
   *   message deletion operation.
   * @param messageIds - The IDs of the messages to delete.
   */
  void deleteMessages(in IExchangeSimpleOperationListener listener, in Array<AUTF8String> messageIds);

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The Exchange client API takes message IDs as UTF-8 strings. ExchangeFolder reads kExchangeIdProperty to build that list; local storage deletion uses nsMsgKey values. Headers without an Exchange ID are skipped only in the remote-ID list, while the success listener retains the whole original header array. Do not describe that skip as preserving those headers locally. This narrower behavior is a source observation; missing-ID and mixed-ID runtime outcomes were not tested. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build or accessibility session was run. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.
title: Keep local message keys and Exchange IDs distinct during deletion
